biggest_catch: The credit is only for new customers enrolling in automatic delivery with auto-pay — will-call customers and existing customers get nothing — and it is a one-time credit on account, not cash. Switching a heating contract to Gault's auto-delivery also locks you into their delivery pricing, so compare their per-gallon rate against your current supplier before signing up.
